hero.headline: Framer vs Strikingly
hero.subheadline: A side-by-side comparison for buyers, operators, and affiliate-content readers.

summary.winner_hint: Framer for design, Strikingly for speed
summary.best_for_a: Framer is best for designers and teams who need pixel-perfect layouts, advanced interactions, and high-performance sites.
summary.best_for_b: Strikingly is best for beginners, solopreneurs, and anyone who wants to launch a clean, single-page site quickly and affordably.
summary.quick_take: Framer and Strikingly solve two different problems: Framer prioritizes design control, animation, and performance for creators who want a bespoke site, while Strikingly prioritizes speed and simplicity with one-page templates and minimal setup. If you want maximum creative freedom and are willing to spend time learning a more sophisticated editor, Framer is the stronger choice. If you need a fast, low-friction site with predictable pricing, Strikingly gets you live the quickest.

paragraphs: Picking the right website builder comes down to the tradeoff between control and simplicity. Framer leans into powerful visual design, interactions, and developer-friendly features, while Strikingly focuses on delivering a simple path to a polished, single-page site.
This side-by-side covers the key differences—ease of use, design flexibility, pricing, SEO, e-commerce, and support—so you can pick the tool that helps you launch faster and convert better.

items.question: Which builder is better for a designer?
items.answer: Framer is better for designers who want advanced control over layout, animation, and responsiveness; Strikingly is too limited for complex design work.

items.question: Which is easiest to launch quickly?
items.answer: Strikingly is the fastest to launch, especially for one-page portfolios or landing pages—templates and onboarding minimize setup time.

items.question: Can I run an online store on either platform?
items.answer: Both support e-commerce: Framer handles more advanced catalogs and integrations, while Strikingly is best for very small stores or single-product sales.

items.question: How do they compare on SEO?
items.answer: Framer offers stronger performance and more control over SEO-relevant output; Strikingly covers basic SEO needs for smaller sites.

items.question: Is there a free plan available?
items.answer: Strikingly offers a free tier with platform branding; Framer typically has a free trial or limited plan but advanced features require paid tiers.

items.question: Can I export my site and move hosts?
items.answer: Framer allows developer-focused options and some export/custom hosting workflows; Strikingly is more closed and designed to host on its platform.
